versions.changelog:
work-productivity-gog-google-workflow-helper 0.1.0 – Initial release.

- Provides practical support for high-demand Gog-style workflows on Clawhub, covering bug fixes, reliability improvements, and adjacent skill creation.
- Delivers concise work plans, templates, checklists, and automation outlines for Google Workspace-related productivity tasks.
- Optimized for local hardware use with scripts and CPU-safe workflows, minimizing reliance on cloud or large models.
- Includes demand and validation criteria to ensure outputs are actionable, reusable, and easy to verify.
- Triggered by common productivity, Google Workspace, and workflow keywords.
